name: Banking and Finance
definition: Queries related to bank accounts, credit cards, balances, payments, and financial transactions.

name: Travel and Navigation
definition: Requests for directions, location finding, ride booking, travel safety, and local business information.

name: Device and Media Control
definition: Commands to control smart devices, play music, manage timers, or interact with phone settings.

name: Food and Cooking
definition: Questions and instructions regarding recipes, cooking times, food safety, and ingredient substitution.

name: Productivity and Organization
definition: Tasks involving scheduling, lists, reminders, and workplace management.

name: General Knowledge and Trivia
definition: Open-ended questions about facts, definitions, currency conversion, and general information.

name: Personal Assistant Configuration
definition: Commands to change assistant settings, user preferences, or the nature of the interaction.

name: Creative and Entertainment
definition: Requests for games, dice rolls, random generation, or other leisure activities.

name: Communication and Messaging
definition: Sending messages, emails, or notifications to contacts.

name: Health and Lifestyle
definition: Managing personal health, fitness, hobbies, and home maintenance.
